purpose: Second seed for the planted-feet physics measurement (bone mass, planted feet, friction cap on projection-induced propulsion) using the corrected scored-interval size_report. Contrasts with seed 38, which found a larger, slip-heavy elite mix.

platform.machine: AMD Ryzen 7 7840HS with Radeon 780M Graphics, 16 logical CPUs

commands: nice -n 15 env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6 EVOLUTION_DEVICES=primary EVOLUTION_CPU_THREADS=6 cargo run --release -q -- headless --population 100000 --seed 39 --generations 20 --duration 60 --checkpoint runs/planted-feet-seed-39.evo
nice -n 15 env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6 EVOLUTION_DEVICES=primary EVOLUTION_CPU_THREADS=6 cargo run --release -q --example size_report -- runs/planted-feet-seed-39.evo 50
nice -n 15 env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6 EVOLUTION_DEVICES=primary EVOLUTION_CPU_THREADS=6 cargo run --release -q --example first_generation

first_generation.note: Same binary and config as the seed-38 run; the random-population check does not depend on the evolution seed.

timing.scope: Headless evaluation calls, including standard and fine perturbed checks. Excludes archive insertion, breeding, saving, and GUI rendering. First call can include pipeline initialization.

top_50.median_convention: size_report selects the upper middle entry for an even sample count.

acceleration_columns_omitted_from_top_50.reason: top-50.csv keeps the same nine columns as 2026-09-26-bone-cap-seed-38/top-50.csv. The current size_report also prints position-derived pos_peak_g, pos_shake_peak_g and the engine value engine_shake_g; position-derived values include position corrections, so they describe visible shaking rather than the engine's head-shake rule.

limitations: One seed at 100k candidates per generation; not a search A/B comparison, a 3M GUI run, or a throughput acceptance test.
CSV values preserve the precision printed by the source logs; top-50 figures are rounded.
Body length is the sum of bone rest lengths, not the body bounding-box span.

Slip is summed horizontal travel of touching nodes over scored replay intervals, divided by absolute terminal replay distance. Post-fall motion and initial recentering are excluded; terrain contact includes slope.

The champion stores 193.0 m but the size_report CPU replay measures 214.8 m. The archive-admission rule only requires the stored score not to exceed the replay; the stored score comes from the evaluation chain, so a replay above the stored score is not an admission failure.

Seed 39 keeps small bodies at the top: 5- and 6-node bodies of 1.5 to 2.6 m and 3.1 to 8.9 kg with slip 0.26 to 0.90. The largest body in the top 50 is 2.81 m and 6.63 kg. This is the opposite mix from seed 38, where 7-node 4 to 5 m bodies of 19 to 24 kg held several top ranks.
The across-seed spread is large: seed 38 best 117.3 m with median slip 1.34, seed 39 best 193.0 m with median slip 0.53. Two seeds are not enough to characterize the distribution.
Machine-local compiler and executable paths were removed. The checkpoint runs/planted-feet-seed-39.evo is local and not committed.

The release binary was built while the worktree also held uncommitted scheduler, UI and Cargo changes from a concurrent session. None of them touch the physics modules (cpu_engine, physics, shaders, config, storage, evolution), so fitness, size and slip reflect the 614e04a physics.

A separate headless evolution in the other workspace shared the machine for this whole run. Fitness values are deterministic and unaffected; the logged evaluation_seconds and wall-clock timing include that contention.
revision_scope: Planted feet (5905316), friction cap (8572d32), bone mass, and CPU archive admission on top of the bd41746 baseline.
